result.evidence: I can offer a final review after the checks; I cannot guarantee 18:30 before we know when they finish.
result.answer:
What you actually agreed to, in your own words: nothing beyond your existing main proposal role, plus a conditional final review offer. You said "I can discuss doing the final review if the data and layout are ready" and "I can offer a final review after the checks; I cannot guarantee 18:30 before we know when they finish." You also explicitly stated "I cannot take all three tasks" and repeated that your capacity limit remains. He accepted the apology and confirmed in his final turn that "Your review stays a conditional offer—nothing accepted yet."

What remained proposals, never accepted: He's plan (Rui checks sources until about 18:20, Ning lays out confirmed content, you review after) — you asked "What would you propose?" and later "Can we leave the deadline conditional?" without saying yes. Rui offered to check sources tonight but never committed. Ning said "I can start layout now—say the word" but nobody gave the word. He proposed sending the proposal with the summary marked pending and said he'd own telling the client and manager if conditions fail; that stayed his stated intention. Not done: the data summary was never checked (you noted this, and Rui's check never happened on screen), layout was never started, the final review never occurred, the exact wording of "pending" was flagged by Rui as unresolved, and 18:30 feasibility was never confirmed.
